## 0.1.0 — 2026-09-14

Published to npm as `@theproductiveschedule/horizon-design-system@0.1.0`, tag [`v0.1.0`](https://github.com/chawsuhlaing2209/horizon-design-system/releases/tag/v0.1.0).

### Added

- [`Button`](/core/components/button/) — Buttons prompt most actions in a UI.
- [`Card`](/core/components/card/) — Use this card component to display content in visually aesthetics, clean and interactive way.
- Types: `ButtonProps`, `ButtonVariant`, `ButtonState`, `CardProps`, `CardState`, `CardLayoutProps`, `CardLayoutOrientation`, `CardImageProps`, `CardImageRatio`, `CardImageState`, `CardTextProps`
- Stylesheets: `tokens.css` and `styles.css`

### Removed

None.

### Requires

- `react` `^19.0.0`
- `react-dom` `^19.0.0`
